problem_statement: Green major bump of @types/node — a types-only devDependency with no runtime surface.

pr.title: Bump @types/node from 22.10.2 to 26.1.1
pr.body:
Bumps [types-node](https://github.com/example/types-node) from 22.10.2 to 26.1.1.
Release notes Sourced from types-node's releases. ## 26.0.0 * Types now target Node 26's `lib.dom` split. No runtime code ships in this package. * **Breaking:** removed the deprecated `NodeJS.Dict` alias.
[![Dependabot compatibility score](https://dependabot-badges.githubapp.com/badges/compatibility_score?dependency-name=types-node)](https://docs.github.com/en/github/managing-security-vulnerabilities/about-dependabot-security-updates) Dependabot will resolve any conflicts with this PR as long as you don't alter it yourself.

problem_statement: Green major bump of date-fns 3 → 4, a runtime dependency. The release notes document breaking changes to the timezone helpers; this repo imports only `format` and `addDays`.

pr.title: Bump date-fns from 3.6.0 to 4.1.0
pr.body:
Bumps [date-fns](https://github.com/example/date-fns) from 3.6.0 to 4.1.0.
Release notes Sourced from date-fns's releases. ## 4.0.0 * **Breaking:** `toDate` no longer accepts a timezone string; use `TZDate` from `@date-fns/tz`. * **Breaking:** removed the deprecated `parseFromTimezone` helper. * `format` and `addDays` are unchanged.
[![Dependabot compatibility score](https://dependabot-badges.githubapp.com/badges/compatibility_score?dependency-name=date-fns)](https://docs.github.com/en/github/managing-security-vulnerabilities/about-dependabot-security-updates) Dependabot will resolve any conflicts with this PR as long as you don't alter it yourself.

problem_statement: Green major bump of express 4 → 5. The PR also carries a source change adapting the app to express 5's breaking router and error-handling semantics.

pr.title: Bump express from 4.21.2 to 5.1.0
pr.body:
Bumps [express](https://github.com/example/express) from 4.21.2 to 5.1.0.
Release notes Sourced from express's releases. ## 5.0.0 * **Breaking:** path route matching no longer supports the bare `*` wildcard; use a named parameter (`/*splat`). * **Breaking:** rejected promises from handlers are forwarded to the error handler. * **Breaking:** `res.status()` validates its argument and throws on a non-integer.
[![Dependabot compatibility score](https://dependabot-badges.githubapp.com/badges/compatibility_score?dependency-name=express)](https://docs.github.com/en/github/managing-security-vulnerabilities/about-dependabot-security-updates) Dependabot will resolve any conflicts with this PR as long as you don't alter it yourself.
